doc.name: G — 30s brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone, a mentor and a student, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone
Hero: a mentor and a student
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone form, built around a mentor and a student.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction in Act 1 against a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll in Act 3 — while holding the a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction, shot on a 105mm macro at f/1.8, framed with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant, shot on a 200mm compression telephoto at f/2.8, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control; grade as a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second brand origin story set in a modern office, wry in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on a 50mm normal at f/1.4, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
